summary.prompt: Summarise the client's objectives and circumstances, at a high level. Do not mention transaction amounts here (top-ups, sale proceeds, the size of any new money, tax figures): those belong in Recommendations and Tax Implications.

recommendation.prompt: Describe what the client should do with their investments, and why, including the amounts involved.

sections.title: Tax Implications
sections.use_if: Include when the advice sells or disposes of investments that may create a taxable gain.

cgt_statement.prompt: State that the disposal may create a capital gains tax liability, assessed against the annual exempt amount. Never state or estimate a CGT amount or rate: that figure is always an adviser-review marker, inserted separately, never a model estimate.
